profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GitHub
profile.summary: Software Engineer who specializes in low-level systems and web services. Has a passion for high-reliability systems and efficient data storage.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Works in the Git Storage team, handling backend storage infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Wrote INTEGRITY RTOS device driver for a USB device. 
- Added product-specific features to INTEGRITY RTOS. 
- Fixed bugs and implemented features in Linux-based React app. 
- Worked with Python and shell scripts to configure Linux. 
- Wrote a new C I/O library as a training project.

positions.title: Grader/Tutor
positions.description: Tutored and graded for the courses: Computer Security (CS181N), Computability and Logic (CS81), Principles and Practice of Computer Science (CS42), and Introduction to Mechanics (PHYS24).

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Maintained and developed the IOTTA Trace Repository, a website that hosts I/O traces. Updated and improved Ruby on Rails code. Implemented database replication and website mirroring.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Learned about the debugging process and how to use tools to debug through solving real-world software bugs. Created materials for teaching debugging to students.

positions.title: Technology Analyst Program
positions.description: Worked with a group inside J.P. Morgan Chase that was developing a web application, using Node.js, Java Spring, and Azure Web Services.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Created a robotic car using Botspeak, a newly developed LabVIEW library, and National Instruments’ myRIO. Developed a tutorial for using the myRIO with Botspeak.

company.name: Tufts University Center for Engineering Education and Outreach

volunteerExperiences.description: Helps plan and implement new student orientation. Provides support to other students and plans events to encourage community engagement.
Acts as a liaison between the Department of Academic Affairs and students. Gives advice to students on academic matters, and creates programs to develop good academic behaviors and patterns.

projects.title: Time Series Compression (HMC Clinic for ServiceNow)
projects.description:
- Participated in Harvey Mudd College’s capstone Clinic project, which consists of doing a project commissioned by a company with a group of three other students. 
- Was the project manager of the team during the spring semester.
- Helped complete a project to implement efficient, loss-less compression of the time-series data
- Integrated the Java storage system with the existing Java LZ4 compression library, created data preprocessors for byte and field transposition, and implemented a compressor based on the algorithm from Facebook’s Gorilla database.
